title: Integral ind-constructible heart is weak Serre
statement: Fix a prime ell, a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ell, and a separated finite-type k-scheme X. Let E be any finite extension of Q_ell with a specified Q_ell-embedding in PadicAlgCl ell. Let Lambda be the condensed ring of continuous functions valued in its valuation ring with the induced topology. For C = IsConstructibleModuleObject Lambda_X [def-sfb-constructible-module], namely finite stratifications with locally finitely presented inverse images, the ambient closure C.ind under small filtered colimits in universe u+1 is closed under kernels, cokernels and short exact extensions. All module sheaves and colimits are ordinary internal module sheaves, with no completeness assumption on ind objects.

source.place: Strict integral intermediate: Integral ind-constructible heart is weak Serre

proof.text: Construct an actual continuous coefficient isomorphism from the spectral-norm valuation ring of ULift E to the embedded valuation ring. Transport the integral finite-presentation/constant-model comparison. Integral constructibles are closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions; their full subcategory is abelian with finite-colimit-preserving inclusion, and is essentially small by finite stratified scalar models.

Apply integral Ext/Hom continuity to complexes concentrated in degree zero. Its degree-zero case makes constructible sheaves finitely presentable. Prove finality of each filtered presentation in the constructible comma category by descending arrows and equalities; this yields the canonical presentation. Apply the finite-stage-square kernel/cokernel construction and exact filtered colimits.

Use the degree-one case of integral Ext/Hom continuity to descend an extension over a constructible quotient stage to a constructible subobject stage. The generic ind-extension argument pushes out these finite-stage extensions, forms their filtered colimit and identifies the result by the short five lemma. Only continuity is used; no uniform Ext-degree bound or finite base field is required.

lean.statement:
theorem ellAdic_integral_indConstructible_weakSerre :
    ∀ (E : Type) [Field E] [Algebra E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [Algebra ℚ_[ℓ] E]
      [IsScalarTower ℚ_[ℓ] E (PadicAlgCl ℓ)] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[ℓ] E],
      let P := ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1}
        (IsConstructibleModuleObject
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E) X.left))
      P.IsClosedUnderKernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderCokernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderExtensions
